apiKeys.intro: Some plugins need a key from an outside service. Keys stay on this device and can't be read back.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers and underscores. Don't start with a number.
apiKeys.removeBody: Plugins that use it will stop working until you add it again.
